units: Gen. R. s. 99 (play on חכלילי, Gen. XLIX, 12) חִיכִּי ערב לי the taste in my mouth is sweet to me (Matt. K. חִיכּוֹ its taste); חיך לי לי sweet taste is mine, is mine; Yalk. ib. 160; Keth. 111ᵇ כל ח׳ שטועמו וכ׳ every palate which tastes it, says, (Give) me; Tanḥ. Vayḥi 10 ח׳ לי לי מיינה וכ׳ (give) me a taste of the wine of the Law.—Trnsf. (cmp. טַעַם) good sense, persuasive word.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:16">Cant. R. to V, 16</cite> (ref. to <he>חִכּוֹ</he>, <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:16">ib.</cite>) <he>יש לך ח׳ גדול</he> (<cite ref="M03031"><he>מתוק</he></cite>) <he>מזה</he> is there anything more persuasive than this?
